fusions.name: Schooled Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water that deals 4 damage, then skips to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Scattering Plunge
fusions.desc: Drops into the middle of a group, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slick Reflex
fusions.desc: Once every 6 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
